column1: # Kinglet Pioneer — upstream content we deliberately did NOT vendor
# The audit trail for what we left behind, so a future ECU bump reports "still skipped" instead of
# silently reinstating content we removed on purpose. scripts/check-provenance.sh enforces it:
# every rule=absent path must stay absent, and every rule=ours-wins path must be origin=original.
# The first column is the path AS IT WOULD EXIST IN THIS REPOSITORY, not upstream's path for it —
# check-provenance.sh resolves it from the repo root, so anything else records a prohibition it
# cannot enforce. The two read the same for most ECU rows only because ECU's layout matches ours.
# Where they differ, the upstream path goes in the reason column.
#   absent     — this path must NOT exist in the repo. check-provenance.sh fails if it reappears.
#                This is what makes the mobile strip stick.
#   ours-wins  — upstream has this path; we ship our own file there instead. The path exists, but
#                its content is ours and provenance.tsv marks it origin=original.
# upstream_path<TAB>upstream<TAB>rule<TAB>reason   (upstream_path is OUR path — see the note above)

Measured 2026-08-13 on GNU coreutils 9.4: call 1 exits 0, calls 2 and 3 exit 1 with `line 30: File: unbound variable` — a bash error on every C# edit after the first, on the only host .claude/UPSTREAM claims. Measured 2026-08-13: 556 staged files before the commit, 0 after, no warning emitted. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-13-surface-criterion-and-gaps-design.md O1

removed 2026-08-13: the surface criterion applied to hooks — the gate blocked the discussion while permitting the act (ground 3). A gate whose false positive is reworded prose and whose false negative is the common staging command teaches quieting a guard by editing the text around it. Its true-positive behaviour is considered for tests/test-bash-gate-precision.sh in the same wave. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-13-surface-criterion-and-gaps-design.md O1

removed 2026-08-13: the surface criterion applied to hooks — the gate blocked the discussion while permitting the act (ground 3). The rule it restates is stated in .claude/rules/unity-specifics.md, which does not claim a hook enforces it. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-13-surface-criterion-and-gaps-design.md O1

removed 2026-08-13: the surface criterion applied to hooks — never runs by default, and not a capability gap (grounds 1 and 3). Exits 0 unless UNITY_NOTIFY_ENABLED=1, which nothing in the shipped tree sets — the only occurrences outside the hook were one commented `//` key in .claude/settings.local.json.template and one test that sets it explicitly. Two of its four event sources (build_complete from build-analyze.sh, verify_fail from stop-validate.sh) are removed in the same wave, and Discord/Slack webhook delivery is not something a Unity toolkit's hook layer is the right place for. Largest hook in the payload at 276 lines. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-13-surface-criterion-and-gaps-design.md O1

removed 2026-08-13: the surface criterion applied to hooks — structurally broken AND not a capability gap (grounds 2 and 3). `CS_MODIFIED=$(echo "$MODIFIED_FILES" | grep -c '.cs$')` is a bare assignment under set -euo pipefail, and grep -c exits 1 when the count is zero; measured 2026-08-13, the hook exits 1 and writes no state file at all whenever the session modified no C# file, silently, with no advisory_exit_guard. Everything it saved (branch, git diff --name-only, git log) is one Bash call away for the model after compaction. NOTE: the spec names three structurally broken hooks; this is a fourth, found by re-deriving rather than copying. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-13-surface-criterion-and-gaps-design.md O1
